entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: Have you heard?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: Yep.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: I just heard it from him.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: He just started, but he's quitting next[n]year, right?

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: It was when he was still little, right?[n]How long has it been since he left[n]with his mother?

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: We were so excited since he came back[n]looking all handsome.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: I am glad that he remembered about[n]this place, though.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: Well, that goes for us too. It's a refugee[n]for people who have a past they want to[n]forget about.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: Especially if they're people we've known[n]for a while. We need to protect them if[n]they're in trouble.

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: Apparently, his reasoning is, "I have[n]something to do in Tokyo."

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: How much do you know?

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: Hey...

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: You're going back because of a[n]relationship, aren't you?

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: Please stop jumping to conclusions...

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: I wish you would have told me...

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: He did say there was someone that[n]helped him out in Tokyo.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: So he's going to do him a favor.

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Employee
entries.en: Right?

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: I'm going to return my debt to him.

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: It's for when they took me in on Christmas[n]Eve, without an appointment... They didn't[n]ask me anything.

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: And also for when they were helping[n]my mom.

entries.speaker: Knowledgeable Employee
entries.en: But still... To think you're going back[n]there to do him a favor... I guess that's[n]like you.

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: If everything goes as planned... Him and[n]his crew...

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: ...Are going to be thanking me for the[n]rest of their lives...

entries.speaker: Young Man's Voice
entries.en: I'm going to go clean the shop.
